result.text:
MASTER PARTICIPATING FACILITY AGREEMENT
This Master Participating Facility Agreement is made on the 26th day of July, 2022 between Summit Care
Alliance and Marlow Children's Hospital.

1. DEFINITIONS
"Effective Date" means July 26, 2022. "Clean Claim" means a claim that can be processed without obtaining
additional information from the Provider. "Medicare Fee Schedule" means the applicable CMS fee schedule
in effect on the date of service. "Plan" means Summit Care Alliance. "Facility" means Marlow Children's
Hospital.

2. TERM
2.1 The term of this Agreement begins on the Effective Date and ends on 25 Jul 2026, unless sooner
terminated.
2.2 This Agreement does not renew automatically. Continuation after the expiration date requires a signed
written amendment.
2.3 Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause by giving 180 days written notice.

3. COMPENSATION
3.1 Acute inpatient services shall be reimbursed at a per diem of $3,050.
3.2 General outpatient services shall be reimbursed at 125% of the Medicare Fee Schedule.

4. CLAIMS
4.1 The Plan shall pay each Clean Claim within 20 days of receipt. 4.2 The Facility shall submit claims
within 365 days of the date of service.

5. CREDENTIALING
5.1 The Plan shall complete credentialing within 45 days of a complete application.

6. GENERAL
6.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Pennsylvania.
Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the financial terms of this Agreement confidential and shall disclose
them only as required by law.
Insurance. Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per
occurrence.
Records. Each party shall retain records relating to services for 7 years following the date of service.
Disputes. The parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute through informal negotiation for up
to 30 days before pursuing other remedies.

AMENDMENT NO. 1
Effective July 26, 2023, the parties amend Sections 3.1 and 3.2 of the Agreement as set out below. All other
terms remain unchanged.
Section 3.1 is deleted and replaced with: "Acute inpatient services shall be reimbursed at a per diem of
$3,200."
Section 3.2 is deleted and replaced with: "General outpatient services shall be reimbursed at 130% of the
Medicare Fee Schedule."
